Overview

Biloxi is a city in MS with a population of 46,000. Gulf Coast casino city with beaches, seafood, and the Biloxi Lighthouse. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
